## Activity

During August 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre completed 5 captures. This represents the recorded activity for the month. The session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational exception was recorded in the information provided.

The completed captures were processed for image assessment and grading. Activity remained focused on the planned service at the site, with routine leave managed within the available arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the 5 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 20.0. This result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable capture could not be used for grading. The image-quality outcome should continue to be monitored through routine review of future captures.

## Grading

A total of 2 results were referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This provides the reported measure of grading timeliness for August 2026. Together, the grading and image-quality results provide a summary of the month’s completed activity, including the number of captures requiring referral and the proportion that could not be graded.
